items: 【Premium Memory Foam】The high density, premium, molded responsive memory foam combines soft and support. Elastic foam material can adjust to your body contour to make up the support your chair lacks. Pillow will never flatten out

【Ergonomic Design】This lumbar support pillow is designed to fit the curve of the waist, which provides different supports for upper, middle and lower back. Effective relief of your back pain and keeps healthy sitting posture

【Breathable Cover】Our lumbar back pillow features a mesh cover to promote air circulation to avoid heat accumulation and skin problems caused by long periods of sitting. Additionally, the cover is removable, machine washable and easy to clean

【Adjustable Straps】LumbarPal lumbar pillow has two extension & adjustable straps, suitable for most kinds of chair such as office chair, gaming chair, wheelchair, car, truck, couch, desk. The great extension straps ensure the pillow can stay where it belongs and will not shift

【Ideal Gift】A warm and practical gift for your loved ones who often sit and work for long periods. Effective relief for fatigue and back pain. Ideal for drivers, teachers, students, office workers, etc
